record_format_note: Draft format (spec §5.7-5.9, §9.4 sketch), same shape as perf_ambient-cm-01/-02 and the BWV 846 records.

performance.title: Cm into Am and F, with a slow C–F–G line (ambient): take 3, rolled piano and forest air

performer.name: Astrid, NetComposer Algorithmic Performer (stand-in script on the box, not the netcomposer CLI)

rules_set_by.note: Same Composition as takes 1 and 2. Peter on take 2: "best piece we've done yet". Take 3 is a sibling: same vibe and rules, new seed, voicings and orchestration.

rule_set.name: ambient Cm (take 3, rolled piano / Rhodes, forest air)
rule_set.section_A: 0-60 s. Six chords, type drawn at random from {Cm, Cm7, Cm9} (no immediate repeat, all three heard, last not Cm7, not the take-1 or take-2 sequence). Voicings drawn without reuse from a new pool (none used in takes 1 or 2). Keys: slow upward Iowa piano rolls (150-450 ms per chord, seeded).
rule_set.build: 38-62 s: pad/keys/drone +6 dB, low-pass opens (pad 1.1->3 kHz, keys 1.7->4 kHz), re-strikes 1 -> 1 (40 s, Rhodes joins) -> 2 (50 s); harp C5, G5, low piano C3, harp C5 plucks at 44.6, 49.6, 54.6, 58.3 s; the pine-forest wind crossfades to soft rain from 56 s.
rule_set.section_B: 60-120 s: Cm7, Am, F, then Cm, Am, F. Rhodes strikes on every chord, Iowa piano rolls added on alternate chords, one re-strike per chord, Iowa cello under each chord (Bb3 / E2 / F3), cello drone C2 (F3 under the F chords), final F rings.
rule_set.line: C5, F5, G5, one note about every 5 s (+-0.4 s seeded jitter) in 20 s cycles from 7 s. Timbre per cycle: guitar, piano, guitar + alto flute (C only), violin, harp + piano, guitar + violin. Every line source is level-matched to the same 1.5 s RMS. Quarter-note triplets (C-F-G in 2 beats) in the rest slot of cycles 1, 3, 4: 0:22.1, 1:01.9, 1:22.1 (piano, harp + piano, piano).
rule_set.musicmatter_share: 2 faint strikes (2 sounds: Cm7 at 0:46, Am at 1:16); about 0.1% of pre-reverb energy
rule_set.pitch_policy: Every pitched sound chosen by NC measurement (pYIN / FFT peak), not by label. Accepted within about +-15 cents (Iowa cello G3 +15 is not used in this take; allan764 F5 +15 c is the outer edge).

known_compromises.what: Freesound sounds are HQ previews (lossy); originals need OAuth, not set up. The two field recordings (klankbeeld 173031, 398425) are long files, so only the first 6,000,001 bytes of each HQ preview were fetched with an HTTP Range request; the hashes cover exactly those bytes. Iowa MIS files are the lossless originals.

The pad is a x2.3 time-stretch of Rhodes notes (Iowa piano fills Bb4/D3/D4/F4 etc. that the Rhodes set lacks, at about x3.7), and the drone is a stretched Iowa cello note, so both carry some phase-vocoder smear.

allan764 G5 (467689) was rejected: its pitch track was unstable (+11 to +114 c across windows, FFT peak +6 to +9 c). The guitar G5 is Skamos66 399476 (CC0, +0.7 c), whose preview is only 1 s long, so guitar G notes are short plucks.
sgossner 373573 is titled "Harp - F#5 (KSHarp_G5_mf.wav)"; it measures G5 -5 c and is used as G5.

Dropped after measurement for this take: Iowa alto flute F5 (+33 c) and G5 (+35 c), Iowa flute non-vib (C5 +17 c with wide spread, G5 measured an octave low), Iowa Bb clarinet (unstable), Iowa piano Ab3 / G2 / D5 (no stable voiced frames in the pp file). Only the alto flute C5 (+1 c) is used, doubling the line C in cycle 3.
Iowa MIS terms are "freely available ... used for any projects, without restrictions", not a formal CC0/PD dedication; treated as public-domain equivalent, credited anyway.

hacks_chain.type: decay flatten (300 ms RMS follower, max +20 dB)
level match: every line source to the same 1.5 s RMS before its gain
equal-power swells; seeded upward piano rolls 150-450 ms; Rhodes strikes 0-50 ms

hacks_chain.automation: dark->bright crossfade 40-60 s, back toward dark over the last 15 s

hacks_chain.build_gain_db: pad/keys/drone -6 -> 0 over 38-62 s; line -1.5 dB in the first half

hacks_chain.type: synthetic hall, generated in the script

hacks_chain.rule: music ends 120 s, 4 s fade, file 124 s
